{{Top|leg}}
'''Gray Thirteen''' was the call sign used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Atril Tabanne]] during [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. Tabanne and Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garik Loran]] were supposed to commandeer two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] at the [[Revos Spaceport]], but when the TIE's were destroyed by Wraiths [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], Tabanne and Loran were picked up by Wraith Squadron's shuttle ''[[Narra]]'' instead.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
